# Eve Plants

> Eve Plants is an ecology-led home plant care service based in Amsterdam and an independent plant-care publication for Dutch homes.

## Core pages
- [Home plant care services](https://eveplants.com/): Home visits in Amsterdam, in-person visits across Noord-Holland by arrangement, online sessions, plant health checks, plant selection and practical care advice.
- [Plant wiki](https://eveplants.com/plants/): 27 plain-language profiles for common indoor plants and Dutch growing conditions.
- [Journal](https://eveplants.com/blog/): Research-backed articles about houseplants in the Netherlands.
- [Shop](https://eveplants.com/store/): An online store is planned; no products are currently sold.

## Editorial approach
- Advice is written for Dutch homes, seasons, daylight and regional tap-water differences.
- Plant care is contextual: check light, soil moisture, drainage, temperature and the individual plant before acting.
- Articles link to primary horticultural or official Dutch sources where available.
- Plant profiles include a direct answer, care table, Amsterdam-home fit, Dutch-winter adaptation, symptom checks, propagation and safety context.
- The site does not diagnose human or animal health conditions.

## Contact
Eve Plants accepts enquiries and appointment requests through WhatsApp at +31 6 8348 3082 (https://wa.me/31683483082).

## Availability
- Amsterdam is the primary in-person service area.
- In-person visits elsewhere in Noord-Holland are available by arrangement.
- Online plant-care sessions are available regardless of location.
